Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.

4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Director NIT Srinagar payable at Director NIT Srinagar . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Director NIT Srinagar . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS & CONDITIONS FOR SUPPLY OF FILLED COMMERCIAL LPG CYLINDERS (19 K G) 1. The supply of filled Commercial LPG Cylinders (19 kg) shall be made to NIT Srinagar. 2. The bidder shall be an authorized LPG dealer of an Oil Marketing Company and shall submit proof of authorization. 3. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of GST, transportation, loading, unloading and all other charges. 4. The cylinders shall be delivered at the designated stores of NIT Srinagar. The supplier shall arrange weighing facilities for checking the weight of cylinders at the time of delivery. 5. The delivery shall be made within two days of the Letter of Award or telephonic instructions from the Estates Officer, NIT Srinagar. 6. The initial supply shall be of 100 filled cylinders. Subsequent supplies shall be made in batc hes of up to 50 cylinders, as per the requirement of the Institute. 7. The successful bidder shall deposit the prescribed security deposit in the form of TDR/Bank Guarantee, which shall be released after satisfactory completion of the contract. 8. All cylinders shall be properly filled, sealed and in good condition. Damaged, leaking or und erweight cylinders shall be replaced by the supplier at no extra cost. 9. Payment shall be made against satisfactory supply, verification and submission of valid bills /invoices, as per GeM terms. 10. In case of failure to supply within the stipulated period or violation of terms and conditions, t he Institute may take appropriate action as per the contract. 11. All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the GeM bid and applicable Government rules.
